business_summary: Mastek Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the provision of enterprise technology solutions in India, the United Kingdom, Europe, North America, Middle East region, South-east Asia, India, Singapore, Australia, and internationally. The company offers digital engineering and experience services, such as cloud migration, cloud engineering, low code, devsecops, quality engineering, MACH, platform engineering, digital experience, digital commerce, and enterprise integrations; data and artificial intelligence (AI) services, including cloud data modernization, cloud engineering, data governance, business intelligence and analytics, intelligent automation, decision sciences and ML, and AI; oracle cloud services, comprising AI, cloud applications, Glide 4.0, e-business suite, consulting, advantedge IaaS, SAP to cloud migration, PeopleSoft to cloud migration, analytics cloud, cloud infrastructure, autonomous data warehouse, value-based analytics, and oracle cloud; and salesforce, such as sales cloud, service cloud, experience cloud, marketing cloud, commerce cloud, industry cloud, mulesoft, data cloud, and Agentforce. It also provides managed platforms; and strategy and consulting services. In addition, The company is involved in the software application development and maintenance, and IT consulting and related activities. It serves government, public sector, healthcare, life science, retail, consumer, manufacturing and technology, financial services, higher education, construction and engineering, hospitality, transportation and logistics, high tech, and media and entertainment industries. Mastek Limited was incorporated in 1982 and is based in Mumbai, India.
